changes.en: cropped to one hindpaw and downsampled in-plane by half from the AmiraMesh source data (Rochester Box public dataset); bone labels converted to analysis regions in the same numbering as the 889 dataset, with a name label for each bone; CT values stored in HU; 3D reconstruction and rendering in this app
changes.ja: AmiraMesh形式の元データ（Rochester Box公開データ）から片足分を切り出して面内を半分に縮小、骨ラベルを889データセットと同じ番号体系の解析領域に変換して骨の名称ラベルを付与、CT値はHUで格納、本アプリで3D再構成

credit.name: Kenney et al., University of Rochester Medical Center
